about.title: About TABACOYA
about.specialtyDesc: TABACOYA is an online specialty shop carrying cigarettes from all Japanese manufacturers. We curate a selection of brands from Japan Tobacco (JT) and other domestic makers, delivering nationwide.
about.missionDesc: Japanese tobacco is crafted with world-class quality control and manufacturing technology. Our mission is to deliver this tobacco culture to enthusiasts across the country, from classic best-sellers to seasonal limited editions.
about.reasonAuthenticDesc: All products are sourced through official channels — guaranteed genuine.
about.reasonShippingDesc: Delivered in as little as 2 days. Shipping is paid by the buyer (by law, tobacco shipping fees apply regardless of order amount).
about.reasonJapaneseDesc: All domestic makers and brands. Japan domestic delivery only.
about.reasonGuideDesc: Strength and flavor guides for beginners and connoisseurs alike.
about.legalPriceNote: As listed on each product page (tax included)
about.legalExtraCostNote: Shipping (flat rate nationwide, paid by the buyer regardless of order amount)
about.legalPaymentTimingNote: Upon order confirmation (bank transfer: within 7 days)
about.legalReturnsNote: Accepted within 7 days for defective or incorrect items only
